works.body:
Nice to meet you. After seeing Maruge-san's illustration, I'd really like to see illustrations of other V-Pai members, so I'm requesting one. I'd like an illustration of Ama-chan. I'd like to see something where she's teaching how to put on a condom while saying, "This is purely for medical study, you know~".

Reference: https://x.com/aiba_short/status/2024657337387295180?s=61 ・The reference video uses a model, but I want her actually putting it on a penis. ・I especially want to see the part starting around 20 seconds in the reference video, where she lifts it up, then lowers it again... repeating that motion.
・If possible, I'd also love to see a variation where he can't hold back and ejaculates just from having the condom put on. Thank you for your consideration. https://x.com/aiba_short/status/2024657337387295180?s=61

Please depict a yuri pregnancy between Futaba-chan from Kitakami and Azuki-chan from Kiso. I'd like it drawn in this sequence: Yuri sex → A depiction of the eggs popping and sticking together → Azuki-chan becoming pregnant and growing a big belly.
